title: Laser Point Sensor
summary: A sensor that outputs a relative x and y position of a laser point that it can see within its field of view.
body: The closest point to the center of the sensor's field of view will be reported. It outputs a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 1 for the x position, and a value of -1 to 1 on composite number channel 2 for the y position. Composite on/off channel 1 is set to on when a point is visible. The -1 to 1 values map to an fov of -cos(0.5) to cos(0.5) in both the x and y directions.

limitations: Family membership and this article's category are editorial. The game's own definition category is a separate field, decoded from the executable in the numeric component codes investigation (investigation/numeric-codes.md).
Tooltips and ports document intended behavior. No game process or native code was inspected by this extractor.
Serialized fields can include defaults for unrelated systems. Their presence alone does not establish an active capability.
Size labels retain component names. Grid bounds, physical bounds and listed voxel counts are different source data; no dimensions are inferred from them.
Singleton fallback. No equivalence with similarly named definitions is asserted.
